name: ordinary and inherited initializer
source:
class A:
 def __init__(self,x=7):self.x=x
class B(A):pass
print(A().x,B(9).x)

name: selected class survives argument rebinding
source:
class A:
 def __init__(self,x):self.x=x
Selected=A
def argument():
 global A
 A=17
 return 9
print(Selected(argument()).x)
